test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Among five friends Poonam, Neha, Rekha, Shruti and Twinkle, Twinkle is taller than only three other friends. Rekha is tallest among all friends. Neha is taller than only one person. Only two persons are taller than Poonam. Who is the shortest among all the friends?
solution:
Given: Among five friends Poonam, Neha, Rekha, Shruti and Twinkle. 

1) Rekha is tallest among all friends.

Rekha > __ > __ > __ > __

2) Neha is taller than only one person.

Rekha > __ > __ > Neha > __

3) Twinkle is taller than only three other friends. 

Rekha > Twinkle > __ > Neha > __

4) Only two persons are taller than Poonam.

Rekha > Twinkle > Poonam > Neha > __

And, the remaining person will be Shruti among the friends.

Rekha > Twinkle > Poonam > Neha > Shruti

So, 'Shruti' is the shortest among all the friends.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
